subject: long-running autonomy observer keeps failing after the correction receipt

root_cause.mechanism: evaluateGoal readPinned still resolves the ORIGINAL evidence_ref whose source_commit is a606873951f69694a9abc17cb196342effdac33f; that commit has no common ancestor with HEAD, so merge-base --is-ancestor exits 1 and execFileSync throws, producing the error
root_cause.why_the_correction_receipt_did_not_help: commit c25386fa6 only APPENDED a second ref; the evaluator still walks the first (original) ref, so the unreachable ref keeps failing
root_cause.not_a_crash: the observer prints a valid observation first; the red CI is the evidence-integrity error path, not a runtime failure

candidate_fixes.change: evaluator treats a ref as satisfied when a reachable correction ref in evidence_corrections points to a byte-verified copy
candidate_fixes.risk: changes evidence-selection semantics; needs a unit test that a superseded ref cannot be used to fake acceptance

candidate_fixes.change: state marks the original ref with superseded_by and evaluator skips superseded refs
candidate_fixes.risk: touches state semantics; must stay append-only (keep the old ref visible)

recommendation: F1 with an explicit allowlist: only refs whose bytes are sha256-verified at a reachable commit may stand in; no acceptance claim may be derived from the substitute
constraints: no reset, no force-push; the original ref stays visible; write with tests first, no deployment today
